visibleTestCases.title: Spawn and Count Dynamic Sessions
visibleTestCases.explanation: Starts dynamic_session_sup and spawns two sessions; verifies count is 2.
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, Sup} = dynamic_session_sup:start_link(), {ok, _} = dynamic_session_sup:start_session(Sup, <<"s1">>, <<"u1">>), {ok, _} = dynamic_session_sup:start_session(Sup, <<"s2">>, <<"u2">>), C = dynamic_session_sup:count_sessions(Sup), unlink(Sup), exit(Sup, shutdown), C end

visibleTestCases.title: Verify Separate Worker State
visibleTestCases.explanation: Queries companion session_worker:get_info to verify separate module state isolation.
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, Sup} = dynamic_session_sup:start_link(), {ok, P} = dynamic_session_sup:start_session(Sup, <<"sess_99">>, <<"alice">>), {ok, Info} = session_worker:get_info(P), unlink(Sup), exit(Sup, shutdown), maps:get(user_id, Info) end

visibleTestCases.title: Terminate Dynamic Session
visibleTestCases.explanation: Terminates one child process and asserts session count decrements from 2 to 1.
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, Sup} = dynamic_session_sup:start_link(), {ok, P1} = dynamic_session_sup:start_session(Sup, <<"s1">>, <<"u1">>), {ok, _P2} = dynamic_session_sup:start_session(Sup, <<"s2">>, <<"u2">>), ok = dynamic_session_sup:terminate_session(Sup, P1), C = dynamic_session_sup:count_sessions(Sup), unlink(Sup), exit(Sup, shutdown), C end
